name: Media Hider
description: Administrator controls for movie and series visibility with optional user groups and one-time per-group reveal schedules. Jellyfin 12.1; English and Polish. File Transformation is required for title-page controls.
overview: Hide titles from all users or selected groups and schedule group reveals.

versions.changelog: Optional user groups, independent one-time reveal date and time for each group, administrator-only fallback without groups, simple catalog thumbnail, and in-memory File Transformation integration. Existing title settings are preserved.
